about_the_game:
DIVE INTO THE WORLD OF AMERICAN STREET RACING

Lead The Dragon combines arcade gameplay with realistic handling , togglable driving assists delivers a pleasing experience for both casual and sim racers. Explore the open world of the twisty roads inspired by the Tail of The Dragon , Interact and challenge rivals in the free roam , escape from the cops and upgrade your car with detailed car customization.

You have to join a crew! There are 3 different crews, each with their own characteristics, delivering gameplay variety and high replayability.

  • American Crew (Anti-police equipament , more crash resistance but challenging RWD handling)

  • European Crew (Light Cars , Better AWD Handling, Fragile to crashes , Pace notes system)

  • Japanese Crew (High Tunning Potential , Drift Focused , Middle Term)

INTERACT AND CHALLENGE RIVALS IN THE FREE ROAM:

  • Point to point races

  • Drift challenges

  • Distance based races

  • Time Trails

COPS WILL HUNT YOU!

  • Roadblocks

  • Pit manuvers

  • Spike strips

  • Collisions

  • Helicopters

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or RX 580 (8GB) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: FullHD (1080p) Native , Low settings 60 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (8GB) or AMD RX 6600 (8GB) or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: FullHD (1080p) Native , High settings 60 FPS

short_description: Join your crew and conquer the narrow roads of America. Explore the open world, earn respect and money by competing in street races, but breaking the law will bring you serious trouble with the police.
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
